title: Camera shot sequence
description: A shot made of catalog presets played one after another; each segment starts exactly where the previous one ended.
$comment: Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by sequences/validate.py: segments[].preset must be an id in presets/catalog.json; segments[].params are merged over that preset's params, where a value of null removes that param (for example {"radius": null} lets an orbit keep the current distance), and the merged preset must pass presets/schema.json (so an override can change or remove values but cannot add a param the preset type does not have). Use {"frame": "camera"} on a dolly, dolly_zoom or crane that follows a turn so it moves along the camera's own axes.
